quote: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal: The driver of a vehicle shall stop in obedience to a stop sign or yield in compliance with a yield sign, in compliance with the manner prescribed in subsection 1 [NRS-484B-257-1], prior to entering an intersection if a stop sign or a yield sign is erected at one or more entrances thereto although not a part of a through highway and shall proceed cautiously, yielding to vehicles not so obligated to stop or yield and which are within the intersection or approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

activation.condition: Vehicle driver approaches a non-through intersection entrance with an erected stop or yield sign, absent controlling officer or signal.

obligation.description: Before entering, stop in obedience to stop sign or yield in compliance with yield sign in the manner of subsection 1; then proceed cautiously and yield to priority vehicles within or closely approaching.

exceptions.trigger: Traffic is controlled by a police officer.
exceptions.effect: Subsection 2 sign-governed duty excepted while officer controls traffic.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Follow actual observed officer direction; legal review is separate.
exceptions.source_clause: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal

exceptions.trigger: Traffic is controlled by a traffic-control signal.
exceptions.effect: Subsection 2 sign-governed duty excepted while signal controls traffic.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Follow actual observed signal; legal review is separate.
exceptions.source_clause: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal

timing.description: Before entry for stop/yield; counterpart occupancy or approach while ego moves across or within intersection.
